title: The Atlantic created a searchable database of the music used to train AI
raw_excerpt: Atlantic reporter Alex Reisner recently uncovered four datasets of music being used to train AI models and made them fully searchable for the public. Two of the sets are absolutely enormous at 12 million and 9 million tracks. The other two are much smaller, but still represent a significant amount of training data at over 100,000 songs each. According to Reisner, the sets have been downloaded thousands of times and, while it's impossible to know exactly who has used them, Google and Stability have both confirmed they have in research papers. summary: 《大西洋月刊》记者Alex Reisner公开了四个用于训练AI的音乐数据集，并制作了可搜索数据库。其中两个数据集规模巨大，分别包含1200万和900万首曲目。谷歌和Stability AI已在研究论文中确认使用这些数据。此举揭示了AI训练数据版权问题的冰山一角，对音乐产业和AI法规有重要影响。

title: chopratejas/headroom
raw_excerpt: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 60-95% fewer tokens, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
summary: Headroom是一个开源工具，可在工具输出、日志、文件和RAG块到达LLM之前进行压缩，减少60-95%的token消耗，同时保持答案质量。它提供库、代理和MCP服务器三种使用方式。今日GitHub获3795星，是当日最热项目之一，对降低AI应用成本有实际价值。

title: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
raw_excerpt: High-performance code intelligence MCP server. Indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph — average repo in milliseconds. 158 languages, sub-ms queries, 99% fewer tokens. Single static binary, zero dependencies.
summary: Codebase Memory MCP是一个高性能代码智能MCP服务器，可将代码库索引为持久知识图谱，支持158种语言，查询时间低于毫秒，token消耗减少99%。它作为单一静态二进制文件运行，零依赖，今日GitHub获1271星，对提升AI编程助手的代码理解能力有重要意义。
